reasoning: This is a multi-component service platform ('Models as a Service') providing managed inference model endpoints on Kubernetes. It consists of three Go sub-services: maas-controller (a Kubernetes controller using kubebuilder/controller-runtime that reconciles CRDs like Tenant, ExternalModel, MaaSSubscription, etc.), maas-api (an HTTP API with OpenAPI spec for key management, tokens, and subscriptions backed by PostgreSQL), and maas-discovery (a tenant discovery service for multi-tenancy). While it includes a Kubernetes controller component, the project as a whole is a service platform — not a standalone operator. It is consumed by parent operators (opendatahub-operator and ai-gateway-operator) rather than being an operator itself, and it provides end-user-facing API endpoints with policy management via Gateway API and Kuadrant/Authorino.
